pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/FramesInspector.tsx:96 The media editors take a direction pass as a per-row proposal that is accepted, refused or reverted by op, revise one noted section of a take, and keep a take's row with a 'gone' mark after its bytes are lost, so review capital is kept instead of regenerated.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/FramesInspector.tsx:96 The direction pass is a proposal accepted per unit, with human layers kept by default (overwrite: false). Revert row/pass ops restore a checkpoint.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/FramesInspector.tsx:86 A beat the pass refused shows the validator's own reason in place of ops, and that row has no accept button.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/ScoreTakes.tsx:96 A revision targets one noted section of a take. The producer (packages/producers/src/score/define.ts:12-14, outside this context) sends that section at 'medium' and every other section as 'keep'. Adherence is fixed at 'medium', not set per note.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/ScoreTakes.tsx:59 When a take's bytes are gone, its row and keep/reject mark stay and the row says the bytes are gone. Only the 'record the destruction in the item' part was checked.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/FramesInspector.tsx:210 Shot-review findings go straight to a human reader. The technique says not to demote findings for a reader who decides rather than acts.

pairs.subject: review-iteration-loops
pairs.evidence: lib/frames/directionPlan.ts:203 directionPlan.ts turns the scene-direction answer into typed EditOps. Rows are accepted one at a time, unaccepted frames are returned by reference, human layers are kept, existing fact bindings are carried forward, and refusals plus untouched beats are listed, so a pass cannot silently overwrite reviewed frames.

techniques.evidence: lib/frames/directionPlan.ts:203 acceptProposal applies ops only to accepted rows. Every other frame is the same object, and a checkpoint lets the whole pass or one row be reverted.
lib/frames/directionPlan.ts:47 The proposal lists unmentioned beats as explicitly untouched (`missing`), and refused beats carry `rejected` with a reason (line 42).

lib/frames/directionPlan.ts:26 keepFactId carries the existing fact binding through a text rewrite, so the edit amends attribution instead of re-deriving it. Only this amendment rule was checked; share-splitting does not apply to frames.

lib/frames/directionPlan.ts:157 Human-touched layers are kept by reference while pass layers are replaced. A subject change marks the plate stale instead of re-rendering it (lines 144-147). No declared seam adherence or anchor-region rule was found.
lib/frames/shotReview.ts:66 Shot-list findings are rendered for a human who decides. No automated stage acts on them, so the fix-or-demote rule does not apply.
